intervals.label: commissioning
intervals.note: The first electrons were injected on or about 2 April 1979 (the author recalls); the first measurable colliding-beam luminosity came on 14 August 1979.
intervals.quote: the first electrons were injected into CESR the next morning, on what would have been April 2 if we had not stopped the clock

intervals.label: e+e- collider operation
intervals.locator: Berkelman, chapter 3; end from the CLASSE CLEO timeline (2008: running ends on March 3rd)
intervals.note: CLASSE dates the first e+e- collisions only to 1979; Berkelman gives the day of first measurable luminosity. The end is the end of CLEO running; CESR continues as the CHESS synchrotron-light source and an accelerator-physics facility.
intervals.quote: It was on August 14 that we had the first measurable colliding beam luminosity.

intervals.label: CESR-c (charm-region running)
intervals.locator: CLASSE CLEO page timelines (CESR: 2003-04 superferric wigglers)
intervals.note: CLEO-c took data at the lower, charm-threshold energies enabled by the superferric wigglers installed in 2003-04.

intervals.label: CLEO running ended; CESR continues as a light source
intervals.locator: CLASSE CLEO page, "CESR and CLEO Timelines"
intervals.note: Particle-physics running ended; CESR still operates as the source for CHESS and for accelerator-physics studies (CLASSE about page). This record covers the collider period only.

name: Cornell Electron Storage Ring
notes: CESR continues to operate after 2008 as a synchrotron-light and accelerator-physics facility; photon science is outside the Atlas scope (A26), so this record covers the collider period.

beam_energy.note: Design beam energy; the text says CESR never ran at it.
beam_energy.quote: CESR never ran at its 8 GeV design energy

peak_luminosity.note: Design luminosity of the proposal at 8 GeV; Berkelman notes it was never achieved under the proposal's parameters and gives later luminosities year by year (Appendix Table I, up to 1.25 × 10^33 in 2001). The source prints the exponent as a superscript, which plain-text copies flatten: "1032 /cm2 sec" in the quote is 10^32 cm^-2 s^-1, and the parameter table after the sentence gives 1 × 10^32 for 8 GeV.

summary.plain: Cornell University's electron-positron storage ring, which first collided beams in 1979 at energies chosen to make the new bottom-quark Upsilon states. Its experiments CLEO and CUSB studied beauty and charm particles until 2008; the ring still feeds Cornell's X-ray source.
summary.technical: CESR e⁺e⁻ storage ring at the Wilson Synchrotron Laboratory, Cornell: proposal 1975, NSF funding 1977, first electrons April 1979, first colliding-beam luminosity 14 August 1979; Υ region (design 8 GeV beams, 10³² cm⁻² s⁻¹); CLEO at the south and CUSB at the north interaction point; CESR-c (charm threshold) from 2003; CLEO running ended 3 March 2008; ring now used for CHESS and accelerator physics.
